vocabulary.definition: an extreme or irrational fear of or aversion to something
vocabulary.example: She has a phobia of spiders and can't even look at pictures of them.

vocabulary.definition: the desire to do something, especially something wrong or unwise
vocabulary.example: The chocolate cake on the table was a temptation she couldn't resist.

vocabulary.definition: fitting in well with a person's needs, activities, and plans
vocabulary.example: The location of the new grocery store is very convenient for us.

vocabulary.definition: making small movements, especially of the hands and feet, through nervousness or impatience
vocabulary.example: The child couldn't stop fidgeting during the long meeting.

vocabulary.definition: relating to or using signals or information represented by discrete values (digits) especially of a binary number system
vocabulary.example: The new camera captures images in high-quality digital format.

vocabulary.definition: the process of making oneself look neat and attractive
vocabulary.example: His grooming habits include daily showers and regular haircuts.
